scoring.rule: Score is decision support only. ADD_NOW additionally requires no unresolved ontology, precision, identity or source-governance blocker. Scores must never be used as population quotas.

candidates.institution: Joint Organisations Data Initiative / International Energy Forum
candidates.series: JODI Oil + Gas World Database first monthly update
candidates.canonical_shape: One SOURCE_BUNDLE occurrence per publication date containing Oil and Gas data products; never duplicate separate oil/gas calendar events for the same update timestamp.
candidates.evidence_note: Official 2026 schedule states first JODI-Oil and JODI-Gas World Database updates occur at noon London time on the listed dates.
candidates.reason: Adds dedicated global gas data while preserving oil/gas as one publication occurrence. Exact official timing, excellent fit to existing SOURCE_BUNDLE ontology, and directly corrects the current oil-heavy energy footprint.

candidates.series: GECF Summit of Heads of State and Government
candidates.evidence_note: GECF states the 8th Summit will be hosted in Moscow on 27 October 2026.
candidates.reason: Adds gas-producer policy at heads-of-government level and broadens institutional/geographic energy coverage beyond IEA/EIA/OPEC. Canonical factual provenance is viable; automated monitoring permission remains a separate later gate.

candidates.series: ICSG biannual meetings / copper market forecast meeting
candidates.evidence_note: ICSG states its next meetings will take place in Lisbon on 13 October 2026.
candidates.reason: Adds a major industrial/transition-metal signal family to an energy/commodities category currently dominated by oil. Exact official date and straightforward institutional-event semantics.

candidates.series: BWC Working Group on strengthening the Convention
candidates.reason: Exact, important and authoritative, but should not be misclassified into human HEALTH_BIOSECURITY merely to diversify that category. Requires explicit security/governance taxonomy placement.

candidates.institution: International Plant Protection Convention / Commission on Phytosanitary Measures
candidates.series: Commission on Phytosanitary Measures annual session
candidates.reason: Strong plant-health/trade-biosecurity signal with exact official timing, but belongs cross-domain rather than as cosmetic diversification of HEALTH_BIOSECURITY. It is also a 2027 schedule-rich series and should enter only through a reviewed next-horizon decision.

candidates.series: WOAH General Session / World Assembly of Delegates
candidates.reason: Substantively important animal/zoonotic-health governance, now with exact 24-28 May 2027 timing, but should not be folded into WHO-style human health solely to repair an institution count.

candidates.institution: RSMC Nadi / Fiji Meteorological and Hydrological Services
candidates.reason: High-value Pacific risk window, but source-native precision is month-bounded. Converting it to 1 November-30 April would be an unsupported precision upgrade under the current canonical timing model.

candidates.institution: RSMC New Delhi / India Meteorological Department
candidates.series: North Indian Ocean tropical cyclone seasons
candidates.reason: Excellent South Asian physical-risk correction, but the authoritative source describes two non-contiguous month-bounded seasons. Current schema cannot represent that honestly without inventing civil-day endpoints.

The native-calendar legal rule is strong, but no authoritative government conversion surface has yet been found for 15 Jestha 2084 -> Gregorian 2027. Third-party calendar conversion is not acceptable canonical provenance.
Official FY2027-28 preparation is visible, but no authoritative future national budget presentation date is yet published. Historical custom is not a forward date assertion.

candidates.institution: Australian Department of Industry / Resources portfolio
candidates.reason: Strategically excellent Australian minerals/energy source, but no authoritative exact next release date was established in this pass. Do not extrapolate quarterly timing from historical cadence.
